topic: Measurements of lift and drag in wind tunnel
syllabus_extract: Measurements of lift and drag in wind tunnel.
specific_objectives: 6.1.5 .1Trainee will be able to explain about wind tunnel operation

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of wind tunnel instrumentation setup, safety checks for high-speed airflow, and instructor supervision of data recording procedures.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a wind tunnel in aerodynamics?
How does airflow velocity relate to lift generation?
Why is drag measurement critical for aircraft performance?

development.content:
Wind tunnel operational principles
Lift measurement instrumentation
Drag measurement instrumentation
Data acquisition systems
Calibration procedures

Force balance mechanisms
Pressure tap distribution
Flow straightening grids
Boundary layer control
Scale model testing

Interpretation of lift coefficients
Interpretation of drag coefficients
Error analysis in measurements
Reynolds number effects
Report generation standards

summary_questions: Explain how a strain gauge measures lift force in a wind tunnel.
Describe the role of a balance in separating lift and drag components.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how wind tunnel data informs the design of future aircraft wings for the next lesson plan.
